# Test fp16 vs fp32 accumulation: large base value where fp16 ULP=2.0, many tiny additions
# that sum to ~2.0 in fp32 (rounding to next fp16 bin) but vanish in fp16 accumulation.
torch.manual_seed(0)
M, N, K = 1, 1, 20000
a = torch.zeros((M, K), dtype=torch.float16)
b = torch.zeros((K, N), dtype=torch.float16)
a[0, 0] = 2048.0          # 2^11, fp16 ULP = 2.0 at this magnitude
a[0, 1:] = 0.01           # 0.01 * 0.01 = 1e-4 per element
b[0, 0] = 1.0
b[1:, 0] = 0.01
ref = torch.matmul(a, b)  # fp32 acc: 2048 + 19999*1e-4 = 2049.9999 -> fp16 rounds to 2050.0
out = matmul(a, b)        # original: 2050.0; mutant (fp16 acc): 2048.0
assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=0.125, rtol=0), f"accumulation precision mismatch {out.item()} vs {ref.item()}"
